MAZDA CX-ḃḀ
Finding that perfect connection is everything. It unleashes a wave of emotion, of elation,
and untaps the potential that lies within. At Mazda, our mission is to find harmony between
human and machine. To create meaningful bonds that rejuvenate the soul. And through
the Mazda CXḋ30, bring joy to every drive.
Its sculpted curves embrace and reflect the surrounding scenery, bringing the still to life.
Its tailored cabin offers a restorative space, with well-appointed features thoughtfully
positioned to rest in perfect alignment with the driver. The all-wheel-drive system, now
standard across all CXḋ30 models, and the available new Carbon Edition, heighten the
exhilaration of every drive. The CXḋ30 is an artful statement, crafted to perfectly anticipate
the needs of its driver: you.

MORE POWER. MORE CONFIDENCE.
From the engine and transmission to the chassis and beyond, we’ve designed every
aspect of our vehicles to work in harmony with you through a holistic approach
we call Skyactiv® Technology. In the Mazda CXḋ30, the available Skyactiv®-G 2.5 Turbo
engine delivers up to 250 hp,1 and is tuned to provide effortless response. And with
up to 320 lb-ft1 of torque, you can feel it with every press of the accelerator, particularly
at low rpm. Smooth acceleration, exhilarating driving dynamics and the power to
take on the world are right in your grasp.

YOUR COMPANION FOR EVERY PURSUIT
The Mazda CXḋ30’s standard i-Activ AWD® delivers an inspired performance over
any road, and helps you drive confidently in the snow and rain too. This innovative
technology uses sophisticated real-time vehicle dynamics modeling to help monitor
traction loss and sends torque to the tires that can use it best. This system works in
tandem with GḋVectoring Control Plus, which can automatically adjust engine torque
and subtly control the brakes at each individual wheel, for a more precise steering
response. The end result is an effortless connection between car and driver.
When your destination takes you off the beaten path, simply press the Off-road Traction
Assist1 control button. Engaging this feature helps optimize torque distribution and
traction control when traversing uneven terrain. No matter where the road takes you,
the CXḋ30 is engineered to ensure you’re always ready for the journey ahead.
1 Off-road Traction Assist helps free tires that are stuck when vehicle tires become embedded in mud, sand or deep snow.

KODO: "SOUL OF MOTION"
A bold intention. Born from our obsession to create beautiful vehicles. Expressed through
our design language called Kodo: “Soul of Motion.” Capturing movement, even at
a standstill. Simplified characteristics that embrace the Japanese philosophy of essentialism.
This compelling evolution in our design aesthetic pursues beauty through subtraction
and purity. Reflections of light across its surface create more intriguing shapes.

A VIBRANT EXPRESSION
Each element of our design process is intentional. Including the paint. Before a single
drop of color is applied, master painters first perfect their technique by hand. Ensuring the
surface of the Mazda CXḋ30 has depth and saturation. They apply color with precision,
illuminating the curves and characteristics of our Kodo design. The machines used to
paint the CXḋ30 are calibrated to replicate the exact movement of this human technique.
Our daring array of lustrous finishes may be the final touch on the CXḋ30, but it is the first
thing that will catch your eye—and continue to draw your gaze, time and time again.
Soul Red Crystal Metallic shown. Available exterior colors, some available at extra cost, vary based on vehicle and package combinations. Visit MazdaUSA.com to see all the vibrant color choices available.

DESIGN WITH A SINGLE FOCUS: YOU.
For decades, we’ve studied the human body: how it moves, sensations of touch, sound
and sight, muscle and skeletal structure. Every consideration has been made so the
Mazda CXḋ30 feels as if it were built just for you. Effortlessly responding to your direction.
This is the human-centric design philosophy known as Jinba Ittai—horse and rider as one.
Our seats further enhance this connection and are shaped to maintain a more comfortable
and relaxed posture, and provide natural balance. The steering wheel and pedals have been
engineered to consider the way the human body moves naturally, so that the car exhibits a
calming sense of poise, handling and comfort. You feel as though your Mazda is an extension
of your body. Leaving you feeling energized. Rejuvenated. You, at one with your Mazda.

BALANCING SILENCE AND SOUND
Letting the right amount of sound in and keeping distracting noises at bay. This is the
very essence of Mazda’s approach to sound. Thoughtful engineering helps reduce
vibrations inside the Mazda CXḋ30’s cabin, and sound insulating materials help further
subdue outside clamor. Measures like this help bring your conversations to the
forefront, and set the stage for a more refined listening experience.
Through extensive research, our engineers calculated the spatial effects and the delay
and reflections of sound to discover the optimal speaker placement and calibrations.
Bringing this all beautifully to life is an available 12-speaker premium audio system
from Bose,® creating the perfect soundtrack for your journey.

AN INVITATION TO GREATER POSSIBILITIES
The Mazda CXḋ30 is the crossover designed to ease into small parking spaces and
transport you to wide-open ones. With a generous cargo area,1 a low platform,
and an available Rear Power Liftgate,2 loading your things is easier. Bring your gear,
your sense of wonderment and the ones you want to share it all with. From shopping
bags to duffel bags, the CXḋ30 makes room for you to seek out all your adventures.
Genuine Mazda Accessory Cargo Cover shown. 1 Please remember to properly secure all cargo. 2 Always check the area around the Rear Power Liftgate before opening and closing it. Please see your Owner’s Manual for further details.

THE HUMAN TOUCH
The Mazda Takumi are the artisans and craftsmen who hone their skills for years, even decades,
to achieve mastery. From their first sketch to the final stitch, their passion, patience and
persistence are poured into every design. The Takumi masters are so highly skilled, they can
carve a block of clay into a work of art. Instinctually, they use their sight, as well as their touch,
to ensure that every curve is perfectly proportioned to their final vision. A process that continues
until this human energy breathes life into the vehicle. From designer to driver, this connection
ultimately creates an enriching emotional bond between you and your Mazda.
Images for illustrative purposes only
